Description

Bambu Lab A1 Combo 3D Printer with AMS Lite for Multi-Colour 3D Printing

The Bambu Lab A1 Combo is a high-speed FDM 3D printer designed for beginners, makers, educators, engineers, and professionals who want reliable, high-quality 3D printing with minimal setup. The printer includes the AMS Lite (Automatic Material System), allowing seamless multi-color printing with automatic filament switching.

Built with intelligent automation, the A1 Combo features full-auto calibration, active flow rate compensation, and a quick-swap nozzle system to simplify the printing process while delivering consistent, high-quality results. With print speeds of up to 500 mm/s and a 256 × 256 × 256 mm build volume, it is suitable for rapid prototyping, functional parts, educational projects, and creative multi-color models.

The printer supports popular materials including PLA, PETG, TPU, and PVA, and integrates seamlessly with Bambu Studio, MakerWorld, and OrcaSlicer for an efficient printing workflow. Whether you're building enclosures for an ESP32 Development Board, creating cases for a Raspberry Pi 5 8GB , or prototyping electronics with an Arduino Uno Original, the A1 Combo delivers reliable and precise results. 

Features

Intuitive Touchscreen Interface

Designed for simplicity, the Bambu Lab A1 Combo features a smartphone-like touchscreen UI that makes operation easy, even for beginners.

High-Speed Precision Printing

Combining a bed-slinger design with CoreXY-like speed and quality, the A1 3D printer uses full-metal rails, a rigid frame, nozzle pressure sensors, accelerometers, and a powerful MCU to achieve fast, precise prints—capable of printing a Benchy in just 14 minutes.

Active Flow Rate Compensation

With a high-resolution eddy current sensor, the Bambu Lab A1 Combo precisely monitors and adjusts flow rates during printing for smooth, accurate extrusion, ensuring flawless details on every corner.

AMS Lite for Multi-Colour Printing

The included Bambu Lab AMS Lite system brings hassle-free multi-colour 3D printing to everyone, offering reliable and user-friendly performance.

1-Touch Filament Loading/Unloading

Forget manual filament handling—A1 automates filament loading and unloading with a simple touch.

Auto Belt Monitoring and Adjustment

The Bambu Lab A1 Combo 3D printer automatically checks belt tension and alerts users if adjustments are needed, ensuring optimal performance through its HMS (Health Management System).

Full-Auto Calibration

From bed levelling to vibration resonance, Z-offset, and nozzle pressure, the A1 3D printing machine fully automates calibration before every print for maximum reliability and quality.

Durable, All-Metal Construction

Built with all-metal rails, bearings, and frame, the A1 is engineered for long-lasting reliability and consistent results.

MakerWorld & 1-Click Printing

Seamlessly print from MakerWorld, Bambu Lab’s next-gen 3D printing model platform, with 1-click printing via the Bambu Handy App or manage prints easily using Bambu Studio and the Handy App anytime, anywhere.

Who Should Buy the Bambu Lab A1 Combo?

The Bambu Lab A1 Combo is ideal for users looking for a fast, reliable, and easy-to-use 3D printer.

  • Engineering Students: Create prototypes, mechanical parts, and academic projects.
  • Robotics Enthusiasts: Print brackets, enclosures, gears, and custom robot components.
  • Product Designers & Engineers: Build functional prototypes and accelerate product development.
  • Schools & STEM Labs: A beginner-friendly printer for classrooms and educational projects.
  • Hobbyists & Makers: Perfect for cosplay, DIY projects, miniatures, and multi-color prints.
  • Small Businesses: Produce prototypes and low-volume production parts efficiently.

Bambu Lab A1 Combo vs A1 Mini Combo: Which One Should You Buy?

Not sure whether to go with the A1 Combo or the smaller A1 Mini Combo? Here's a side-by-side breakdown of the key differences to help you decide:

Our take: If print size matters to you — for helmets, terrain boards, large prototypes, or anything over 18 cm — the A1 Combo is the clear choice. If you're working in a tight space or primarily printing smaller models and miniatures, the A1 Mini Combo saves you ₹8,600 without giving up speed or multi-color capability.

FAQ

Is the Bambu Lab A1 Combo worth buying?

If you're looking for a reliable, beginner-friendly, and high-speed 3D printer with automatic multi-color printing, the Bambu Lab A1 Combo offers excellent value. Features like AMS Lite, full-auto calibration, and smart software integration reduce manual setup and improve overall printing reliability.

Can I use third-party filaments?

Yes. The Bambu Lab A1 Combo supports a wide range of compatible third-party filaments, including PLA, PETG, TPU, and other supported materials, provided they meet the recommended specifications.

Does the Bambu Lab A1 Combo require manual bed leveling?

No. The printer performs automatic bed leveling and calibration before every print, reducing setup time and improving first-layer consistency.

Does the Bambu Lab A1 Combo support Wi-Fi printing?

Yes, the Bambu Lab A1 Combo supports Wi-Fi printing. You can send print jobs wirelessly using Bambu Studio or the Bambu Handy app, without needing a USB drive or SD card. This allows easy file transfer, remote monitoring, and a more seamless printing workflow.

How many colours can the Bambu Lab A1 Combo print?

The A1 Combo includes the AMS Lite, which holds 4 spools for up to 4 colours or materials in one print.

What is the build volume of the A1 Combo?

The Bambu Lab A1 Combo has a 256 x 256 x 256mm build volume, the same as the standard A1, so it handles most functional parts and models.

Warranty Coverage Includes:

Warranty Exclusions (This Warranty does not cover):

  • Normal wear and tear of consumable parts (e.g., nozzles, belts, bearings, print beds, hotend, extruders etc.).

  • Issues arising from the use of non-approved third-party components, accessories, or filament.
  • Software-related issues, firmware modifications, or unauthorized updates.
  • Damage caused by external factors such as power surges, environmental conditions, or improper storage.

Limitation of Liability
